---
title: The plans switch between monthly and annual billing
priority: P1
tags: [eval]
device: [pixel, win-chrome]
---
## Steps

1. Open /upgrade.
   Expect: the plans with monthly prices; the billing toggle shows monthly as selected.
2. Switch the billing to annual.
   Expect: the toggle shows annual; the prices change to the annual ones and a note explains the saving; the same
   plans as before.
3. Switch back to monthly.
   Expect: the monthly prices from step 1 again.
